text:
Maya G: Quick heads-up — planning a 2-week micro experiment for webinar registrants. We'll test 3 onboarding prompt-template variants + a small credit reallocation. Goal: +25% reg -> first API call activation. Launch Tuesday after dry run. :rocket:

Hiro T: nice. what's the segmentation? all webinar regs or only those who clicked the invite? :thinking_face:

Maya G: all regs who finish RSVP page (so includes waitlist accepts). We'll randomize at lead ingestion. Sampling: 50/30/20. Tracking targets: first_api_call, used_prompt_template, credit_redeemed.

Samir: can we get the measurement window upfront? 7 days post-reg sounds reasonable. Also need Amplitude events + a dashboard tile.

Maya G: agree — 7d conversion window. Samir can you own the dashboard?

Samir: yep, I'll wire up a cohort and funnel metric. tagging events now: `first_api_call`, `prompt_pack_assigned`, `credit_bucket`. Will add retention curve.

Elena (PM): copy and lead-routing question — if someone redeems >1 variant (edge case), prefer the highest credit assignment. Also, need 1-line email copy for each variant for the post-reg email. I can update Zapier routing to add `experiment_variant` to HubSpot.

Maya G: perfect. Variant spec (draft):
```
variant_A - Baseline (50%): baseline prompt pack + 50 starter credits
variant_B - Activation Boost (30%): tailored prompt pack + 100 credits + quickstart checklist
variant_C - Template Pack (20%): curated prompt templates + 25 credits + workshop invite
```

Hiro T: love the naming. For templates, can we surface 3 vertical starter prompts (sales, docs, search) to increase relevance?

Maya G: yes — verticalized template sets for B and C. B gets 3 vertical prompts inline in onboarding; C gets a downloadable pack.

Elena (PM): copy drafts — short lines for the post-reg email.

Maya G: (variant A) "Thanks for joining — jump in with 50 credits and our quickstarter prompts."

Maya G: (variant B) "You're in — get 100 credits + tailor-made prompts to get to value fast." :sparkles:

Maya G: (variant C) "Welcome — grab a curated template pack and join our live workshop for pro tips." :calendar:

Samir: quick ask — can we add an event `workshop_rsvp` so we can see C funnel uplift from invites?

Elena (PM): will add `workshop_rsvp` to the tracking doc and update HubSpot tag mapping.

onboard-bot: experiment created: `exp_1747401234_webinar_promptpack_v1` — sampling 50/30/20. Dry-run queued at 09:00 PT on Monday.

analytics-bot: tracking plan updated: added events [`first_api_call`,`prompt_pack_assigned`,`credit_bucket`,`workshop_rsvp`]. Amplitude schema link: https://amplitude.company/schemas/exp_1747401234

Hiro T: timeline check — copy + templates by Monday EOD, dashboard ready by Wednesday, full launch Tuesday next week?

Maya G: yep. Samir + Elena + Hiro — sync Monday 10am to confirm dry run results. Post-launch retrospective scheduled 2 weeks after start. :eyes: 

Elena (PM): I'll drop the updated Zapier mapping + email HTML snippets in #marketing-docs by EOD Monday.

Maya G: thanks everyone — want minimal friction on the RSVP -> API path. If you see any edge-case routing (multi-regs, duplicates) flag here. :pray:
